summary: KFIT iteration 8 — first full run with the non-admin CLIENT account. SCOPE: login + role gating + RLS write-refusals + storage probes + exercise-sheet no-video-player + catalog/program/favorites/contact/booking/progress/coach/nutrition flows. RESULT: all client-visible flows work; access-control is correctly enforced on both the UI (admin-denied, no profile-link-admin) and the Supabase REST (insert on programs refused 403; PATCH/DELETE on exercises affect 0 rows and sample-plank untouched) and Storage (write on bucket videos refused 400/403). Role badge profile-role reads 'CLIENT' in FR (verified live). (A) LOGIN: /welcome -> welcome-login-button -> login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button -> home-screen OK; backend /api/auth/me returns 200. (B) ADMIN gating: profile-link-admin count=0; direct /admin -> admin-denied shown (screenshot /tmp/iter8_admin_denied.png: 'Cet espace est réservé aux administrateurs KFIT.'); /admin/edit?kind=program -> admin-denied shown, no form. (C) Exercise sheets — client sees NO video player for Push-ups / Goblet Squat / Plank at any level: for Push-ups, levels beginner/intermediate/advanced all return <video>=0, video-player=0, exercise-video-draft=0, video-unavailable=1 (screenshot /tmp/iter8_pushups.png: 'La vidéo n'est pas encore disponible.'); same for Goblet Squat and Plank (default level checked). Exercise sheet shows level/muscles/equipment translated ('Niveau Débutant', 'Muscles Pectoraux, Triceps, Épaules, Gainage / abdos', 'Matériel Aucun matériel'), 'Selon le niveau' chips with 3 séries / 8-10 rép. / 60 s repos, note 'Pose les mains sur un banc, une table solide ou un mur…' and 'Consignes' list — all French. (D) RLS/REST (file /app/tests/client_role_rest_tests.py, 16 tests PASS): users?select returns exactly the client's own row with role='client'; client_profiles returns 0 or own row; programs/videos/exercises visible with >=3/10/38 rows respectively; POST /programs {slug:'rls-probe'} -> 403; PATCH /exercises?slug=eq.sample-plank {level_variants:{}} -> affected 0 rows, sample-plank.level_variants unchanged; DELETE /exercises?slug=eq.sample-plank -> affected 0 rows, sample-plank still present. (E) STORAGE: POST /storage/v1/object/videos/_probe/x.txt refused; DELETE on non-existent /storage/v1/object/videos/_probe/<rand>.mp4 refused. (F) STORAGE READ (FINDING 5 confirmed, not a bug per owner): GET /storage/v1/object/authenticated/videos/drafts/exercises/sample-plank.beginner.fr.mp4 with Range bytes=0-1023 returns 206; POST /storage/v1/object/sign/... returns 200; POST /storage/v1/object/list/videos {prefix:'drafts/exercises/'} lists sample-* files. Also table exercises exposes media_path for the 3 draft slugs (drafts/exercises/sample-*.mp4) to the client. (G) BACKEND flows (same test file): /api/progress POST+GET+DELETE OK; /api/bookings POST+GET+DELETE OK; /api/coach/chat streams SSE deltas -> /api/coach/messages lists 2 messages -> DELETE empties; /api/nutrition/plan POST returns full {calories,protein,carbs,fats,summary,meals[4],tips[3]}. (H) UI FLOWS: progress — progress-weight-input '72.5' + progress-save-button -> progress-entry count=1 -> progress-delete-<id> removes it (count=0). booking — booking-date-* (14 visible), booking-slot-* (6 visible), booking-confirm-button -> booking-item count=1 -> booking-cancel-<id> -> count=0. contact — invalid phone 'abc' + contact-save-button shows error text (2 matching error elements); valid '+52 984 000 0000' + Calle Test 1 / 77760 / Tulum / Quintana Roo / Mexique -> contact-saved visible; reload preserves phone='+52 984 000 0000' and city='Tulum'. coach — tab-coach -> coach-input 'Bonjour' -> coach-send-button -> at least one bubble; coach-clear-button empties the thread (REST verified 0 rows). favorites — favorite-button on Plank exercise sheet toggles ON. (I) LANGUAGE — profile-lang-* buttons exist (en/es/fr) and are expected to swap the role badge; full EN/ES verification was abbreviated due to a tab-profile click timeout from /contact route (non-blocker; REST already confirms role='client' and the UI shows 'CLIENT' in FR). (J) CLEANUP (done): Supabase favorites/workout_history/program_enrollments for the client user_id are now [] (verified); preferences set to {} (clean); /api/progress, /api/bookings, /api/coach/messages all return []; nutrition plan remains in /api/nutrition/plan (NO delete endpoint — tracked as finding). No change to sample-plank or any admin-owned row/file. (K) QUALITY: no red-screen, no raw codes, no broken images on home/training/exercise screens; welcome image and Push-ups/Goblet/Plank thumbnails render; load < 5 s after first bundle. (L) WHAT COULD NOT BE TESTED this run: full enroll → video-complete-button → video-done-count '× 1' → home-program-percent refresh flow (the direct deeplink route on exercises got priority; program enroll was partially exercised through REST tests but not end-to-end in UI); EN/ES role-badge and home screenshot in those languages (abbreviated after /contact navigation glitch); 'draft programmes are hidden from a client' can only be asserted as 'the client sees exactly the 3 published programmes / 10 videos / 38 exercises' because the database currently has no unpublished rows (reported as such, not claimed as verified). Deprecated packages detected: NONE. SafeAreaView issues detected: NONE. Expo deprecation warnings are the known expo-router warnings on web (expected).
action_items: FINDING (item 5, already confirmed by main agent; left in place per owner): the client token can GET drafts/exercises/*.mp4 with Range, POST /storage/v1/object/sign/..., POST /storage/v1/object/list/videos {prefix:'drafts/exercises/'} and SELECT exercises.media_path even when media_path points at drafts/. If this is unintended, tighten the 'videos' bucket authenticated-read policy and/or restrict SELECT on exercises.media_path to published, non-drafts paths or to role=admin. If intended (the UI gates draft playback by isDraftMedia(...) && role!=='admin'), state it explicitly in the RLS/storage docs.

FINDING: POST /api/nutrition/plan creates a persistent row (unique on user_id) but there is no DELETE endpoint. The test left the client's nutrition plan in place. Suggested fix: add `@api.delete('/nutrition/plan')` symmetric to /coach/messages so a client can erase the plan.

MINOR UX: in a web browser (Metro web preview), clicking tab-profile after arriving on /contact via deep navigation can timeout waiting for the tab bar to re-attach. Not reproducible systematically; no user report; low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:338-341 del_progress silently returns ok even when no row matches the (id,user_id) filter. Consider returning 404 when deleted_count==0 to match /bookings behaviour (server.py:485-490).

backend/server.py:380-399 /api/nutrition/plan upserts the plan but there is no counterpart DELETE and no size/age limit on the stored document (relies solely on AI_LIMITS). Consider adding DELETE and a TTL index for abandoned plans.
app/exercise/[id].tsx:36-38 isDraftMedia(media_path) && user.role!=='admin' sets media=null — confirmed live for Push-ups/Goblet Squat/Plank (video-unavailable shown at every level). Correct.

app/admin/index.tsx:57 and app/admin/edit.tsx:137 both emit testID='admin-denied' when user.role!=='admin'. Confirmed live for the client account on direct navigation to /admin and /admin/edit?kind=program.

RLS review: users SELECT returns only auth.uid()'s row to a client (verified); client_profiles SELECT only mine (verified); POST on programs refused with 403 (verified); PATCH/DELETE on exercises returns an empty representation list (i.e., 0 rows affected) rather than 403 — this is correct RLS behaviour but can be ambiguous for an API consumer; consider explicitly denying via RLS policy to return 403 on these too, for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 10/11 flows green: login, role=CLIENT, profile-link-admin absent, /admin admin-denied, /admin/edit admin-denied, exercise sheets video-unavailable for Push-ups/Goblet/Plank across levels (no <video>, no exercise-video-draft), progress add+delete, booking book+cancel, contact invalid-phone rejected + valid saved + persist after reload, coach send message. NOT VERIFIED THIS RUN (abbreviated): full enroll→complete→home-program-percent UI loop; EN/ES role-badge snapshot; programme sheet (program-detail-screen) deep walk.

seed_data_creation: Created via the CLIENT account and then DELETED in cleanup: 1 progress entry (id removed via UI progress-delete-<id>); 1 booking (cancelled via booking-cancel-<id>); 1 Plank favourite (deleted via REST DELETE /rest/v1/favorites); coach messages for 'Bonjour' (deleted via DELETE /api/coach/messages and reconfirmed empty via GET). Preferences reset to {}. Nutrition plan (1 generation) LEFT IN PLACE because /api/nutrition/plan has no DELETE endpoint — see action_items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client-role test suite is at /app/tests/client_role_rest_tests.py; export KFIT_CLIENT_EMAIL/PASSWORD and run `pytest tests/client_role_rest_tests.py -v`. Supabase column names used by the app: users.id/role/full_name (NO 'email' or 'user_id' on users); client_profiles.user_id (PK, not .id); programs.title/description are jsonb {fr,en,es}; programs.goal values are the enum fitness_goal ('weight_loss','muscle_gain','strengthening',…) — NOT 'muscle'; favorites PK is (user_id,item_type,item_id) — there is no favorites.id column. Admin-denied testID is 'admin-denied' on both /admin and /admin/edit. Booking testIDs are booking-date-YYYY-MM-DD, booking-slot-HH:MM, booking-type-{gym,outdoor,online}, booking-cancel-<id>. Contact testIDs are contact-{name,phone,address1,address2,postalCode,city,region,country}-input + contact-save-button + contact-saved. Progress has progress-delete-<id> per entry. Draft videos: client CAN read drafts/* through authenticated storage API (owner-acknowledged finding).
rca_of_issue: n/a — no regressions found this iteration. Two existing design observations (no DELETE on /api/nutrition/plan; client can read drafts/* in storage) are called out as action items and were not treated as defects per the review request's explicit guidance.
